identity_proposed.reason: Keep existing raw dir0700/file0600 readable by job UID999; do not reuse existing host GID999(systemd-journal).

storage_proposed.consumer_manifest: independently controlled outside bundle/chroot; receiver has no write authority

format.request_id: original validated request id; no schema changes

sender_contract.precheck: Producer stopped writing; existing verify_bundle(local_bundle, original_manifest_raw, require_complete=True) succeeds; only declared verified responses uploaded.

sender_result.exit_0: Local precheck and entire SFTP batch succeeded; transfer only, not receiver hash validation or DB.
sender_result.exit_1: Any precheck/rejection/transfer/transport failure or unknown completion; no DB continuation.
sender_result.native_sftp_rc: record verbatim; null if unknown; do not invent native error codes

security_boundary.server_enforces: Chroot, permissions, key-only internal SFTP, request allowlist, no shell/forwarding/download/delete/chmod.
security_boundary.sender_enforces: Fresh run mkdir claim + batch abort on any error + index published last; same-run no concurrent mutation/consumption.
security_boundary.server_does_not_enforce: Authenticated receiver can still rewrite own existing files via allowed open/write/posix-rename; no server-enforced write-once or verification receipt.
